postings.title: Senior AI Engineer
postings.description:
About 9fin

9fin is the AI platform powering global debt markets — the world’s largest asset class at over $145 trillion.

Debt markets are vast, global, and mission-critical, yet still run on fragmented data, PDFs, and manual workflows. 9fin replaces this broken infrastructure with a single platform that centralises proprietary credit data, deep analysis, and high-value workflows across global markets.

Today, 9fin powers teams at 300+ blue-chip institutions worldwide, including global banks, asset managers, private equity firms, law firms, and advisors. The business is scaling at exceptional speed, with rapid expansion in the US and best-in-class retention driven by deep workflow adoption.

We’re at a defining inflection point. With proven product-market fit and strong, global market pull, 9fin is accelerating toward becoming the category-defining platform for debt markets worldwide.




THE OPPORTUNITY

The Data Science team is growing at 9fin! We are doing world-class work with groundbreaking technologies to build data-driven products using machine learning, computer vision, natural language processing, speech and audio, and knowledge/data mining. We are looking for a Senior AI Engineer to accelerate our application of AI across teams and products. Come and join us, you will get to build large-scale AI powered systems, learn and apply the latest techniques, and work alongside other great researchers and engineers!

Every day is different, but here's an example of the kind of things you'll work on:

 - Design and build generative AI applications tailored to complex financial and legal workflows, leveraging state-of-the-art models to deliver innovative, practical solutions that streamline decision-making and unlock new efficiencies.

 - Drive end to end model development lifecycle, leading the team in best practices, ensuring reproducible research and well managed model delivery/deployment.

 - Collaborate cross functionally to share diverse ideas, understand business problems, and elevate/mentor your teammates.

 - Translate complex problems into well-defined scoped bets in an internal startup style environment, dynamic and fast-paced.

 - Learn and apply ground-breaking research and approaches in advanced topics, iterating improvements with a fail fast mentality.

 - Be a proactive sharer of compelling ideas/work to the rest of the team and organisation. We want you to help lead/push the adoption of AI throughout 9fin.


ABOUT YOU

This role will be a great fit if you:

 - Strong proficiency in Python for production ready delivery.

 - You’re an expert in any of the following areas - deep expertise in one and familiarity with others is ideal:
   
   - Information Retrieval: chunking strategies, (finetuning) embedding models, training re-rankers.
   
   - Entity/relationship extraction/resolution
   
   - Knowledge Graphs; building and inference, graphRAG
   
   - Recommendation systems and ranking: personalisation, learning-to-rank, feed ranking, user modelling, etc.
   
   - Tabular ML: feature engineering, structured data modelling (GBDTs, etc.)
   
   - Statistical & Predictive Modelling: supervised ML, anomaly detection, temporal modelling, etc.
   
   - Deep understanding of the GenAI landscape and agentic frameworks.

 - Experience working in the full model lifecycle (including experimentation, training, testing, monitoring, and deployment). We are data centric and love our evals!

 - You have a strong product focus with a desire to understand the end-to-end impact of your solutions for our end users.

 - Good knowledge of AWS’s AI infrastructure.


BENEFITS

We’re a scaling start up, and we enjoy sharing our success, when the company succeeds, we always reinvest that in our people. We also offer huge amounts of responsibility, an abundance of opportunity for growth and a platform to truly excel.

Financial & Insurance

 - Competitive Salary (our salary bands are benchmarked at the top end of the market)

 - Equity

 - Pension (your minimum contributions are 4% with 9fin matching up to 7%)

 - Private Medical Insurance

 - Paid sick leave with Income Protection for long periods of illness

 - Group Life Assurance 

 - Season Ticket Loan & Cycle to Work schemes

Time off 

 - 25 holiday days per year

 - Local public holidays (with the ability to exchange them for alternative days)

 - Hybrid working model

 - Work abroad for up to 3 months a year

 - 1 month paid sabbatical after 5 years of service

 - Enhanced parental leave & flexible working arrangements available

Training & Culture 

 - Professional learning and development budget

 - AI experimentation budget of £800 (UK) per employee to trial AI tools

 - Quarterly team socials

 - Summer and Winter company social events
   

Hybrid Policy

9fin is a hybrid company, and the office is a regular part of how we work. From January 2027, all employees will work from their designated 9fin office on Tuesdays and Wednesdays. This is a new-business leadership role. You'll manage a team of 6 Account Executives who win new buy side clients. A separate AM Director manages the Account Managers who own books of existing buy side clients, and you'll partner closely with them on handovers, renewals and expansion. Every client engagement is a source of product intelligence. The insights you bring back from the front line will directly influence 9fin's AI product roadmap and sharpen how we win the next generation of buy-side accounts.

 


WHAT YOU WILL DO

 - Map investment workflows and find the highest-value insertion points. Embed with client teams to document how sourcing, screening, underwriting, credit committee preparation, portfolio monitoring, and relative value work actually gets done end-to-end. Identify the three to five places where 9fin's AI can materially change the workflow. Co-author adoption success criteria with the client, tied to their investment outcomes.

 - Build 9fin's AI into those workflows. Take the identified insertion points and build them out using 9fin's toolkit: in-platform capabilities, MCP integrations, agents, and future capabilities as they ship. Weighted by workflow depth, not count. Iterate based on real usage behaviour, not intended usage.

 - Drive adoption at your served accounts. Onboard named users across investment, research, and risk. Run enablement sessions with power users, identify and support champions inside the client. Monitor active usage and address dormant seats before they become churn signals. Review adoption monthly with client champions and quarterly with the CIO, head of research, or equivalent sponsor.

 - Feed the field back into 9fin. Every deployment produces structured intelligence, fed to two consumers. First, product and engineering: prioritised requests tied to specific account and workflow context, patterns extracted across deployments. Second, the wider GTM cycle: case studies, demo assets, workflow evidence, and competitive intelligence that sharpen the next GTM cycle.

 - Spot expansion. Identify opportunities inside served accounts for new users, new use cases, new departments, or new products. Document with context and hand to Account Management for commercial follow-up.

 - Private credit and direct lending. Origination, underwriting, documentation review, or portfolio monitoring at a private credit or direct lending platform

 - CLO investing. CLO management, warehouse and portfolio construction, or CLO debt and equity tranche investing

 - Distressed and special situations. Stressed and distressed credit analysis, restructuring and process tracking, documentation and covenant analysis, or capital structure work

Investment data, quantitative or systematic credit research, chief data office, digital transformation, or AI strategy roles where you have led or contributed to AI and workflow transformation projects specifically in credit investing

Today, 9fin powers teams at 300+ blue-chip institutions worldwide, including global banks, asset managers, private equity firms, law firms, and advisors. The business is scaling at exceptional speed, with rapid expansion in the US and best-in-class retention driven by deep workflow adoption.

We’re at a defining inflection point. With proven product-market fit and strong, global market pull, 9fin is accelerating toward becoming the category-defining platform for debt markets worldwide.




THE OPPORTUNITY

We are bringing Client Engagement together as a single global function under our Global Head of Client Engagement. We are hiring Regional Directors to lead it on the ground. You will own retention, adoption and growth for your region (EMEA or the Americas), lead a team of Client Engagement Managers across a tiered coverage model, and turn client insight into action across the business.

This is a role for a proven CS or AM leader who wants to scale a function. You will inherit a strong foundation, shape the next stage, and be accountable for commercial outcomes: gross and net revenue retention, product adoption, and the health of our most important client relationships.




WHAT YOU’LL WORK ON

Every day is different, but here is the kind of work you will lead:


LEADERSHIP & TEAM DEVELOPMENT

 - Lead, coach and develop a regional team of Strategic CEMs, Senior CEMs and Client Engagement Managers across the whole region, and the managers beneath you as the team grows.

 - Run a tiered coverage model: Strategic CSMs for our most important accounts, Senior CSMs for key accounts, and CSMs for the wider base. Define clear roles, service levels and career paths at each level.

 - Hire, onboard and train to a rapid growth plan, with a strong bench of internal successors.


RETENTION, ADOPTION & GROWTH

 - Own regional gross revenue retention (GRR), with clear early-warning signals and remediation plans for at-risk accounts.

 - Drive seat-level adoption: activate and re-activate users, build champion networks, and embed 9fin in each client’s daily workflow.

 - Lead adoption of our newest products, including 9fin AI and Private 9fin, with client-specific programmes and measurable usage goals.

 - Design role and client-specific adoption metrics that forecast usage trends, so the team drives usage proactively.

 - Partner with Account Management and Relationship Managers on renewals and expansion, with clear ownership at each stage of the client lifecycle.


STRATEGY & OPERATING MODEL

 - Translate the global Client Engagement strategy into a regional plan, with the playbooks, success plans and lifecycle programmes to execute it.

 - Use health scoring and usage data to decide where the team spends its time, and to move accounts between coverage tiers as their needs change.

 - Report regularly on regional KPIs to global leadership: retention, adoption, health, renewals and expansion pipeline.


VOICE OF THE CLIENT

 - Represent clients in conversations with Product, Engineering, Data and Editorial, backing requests with evidence such as the accounts affected, the ARR at stake and the workflow impact.

 - Work with our Forward Deployed team on strategic accounts, setting shared success criteria and feeding what you learn back into the product.

 - Build executive relationships with senior stakeholders at your region’s most important clients.


OPERATIONAL EXCELLENCE

 - Use Salesforce, our analytics tools and client engagement platforms to make the team more proactive, with automation where it frees up time for high-value work.

 - Keep playbooks, client communications and dashboards current, and create feedback loops that improve the client experience.


WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

 - Within 3 months: a clear picture of your region’s accounts, risks and team, and a regional plan agreed with the Global Head of Client Engagement.

 - Within 6 months: accounts assigned and covered under the tiered model, with health scoring in use and a visible improvement in early-warning response.

 - Within 12 months: measurable gains in regional retention, adoption and AI and Private 9fin usage, and a team with the capacity and leadership depth to keep scaling.


REQUIREMENTS

This role will be a great fit if you have:


EXPERIENCE & EXPERTISE

 - 8+ years in Customer Success, Account Management or related client-facing roles in Capital Markets, Enterprise B2B SaaS or Financial Data, including 3+ years leading teams.

 - Experience managing AMs, CSMs, AEs or building the layer of leadership beneath you, ideally across more than one region or client segment.

 - A track record of scaling or structuring a CS or AM function through a period of fast growth.

 - Strong understanding of global financial markets, and credibility with buyside, sellside and advisory clients.


COMMERCIAL ACUMEN

 - Proven success driving retention, adoption and expansion in enterprise accounts, ideally accountable for a portfolio of $50m in ARR.

 - Comfort being measured on GRR, NRR and adoption, and designing the KPIs, dashboards and forecasting that support them.

 - Experience working alongside sales and account management on renewals and expansion, with clear ownership between teams.


LEADERSHIP & COMMUNICATION

 - Excellent people leadership: you coach, develop and hold a high bar for high-performing teams.

 - Clear written and verbal communication, with the ability to influence senior stakeholders both inside 9fin and at clients.

 - The judgement to prioritise competing demands and to use data to decide where the team focuses.


BONUS POINTS

 - Existing relationships in the Leveraged Finance, Debt Capital Markets or Restructuring community.

 - Experience in a high-growth fintech or data provider, or with seat-based professional data products.

WHY JOIN US?

You will join a fast-moving, ambitious team helping to power the largest financial market in the world. This role offers the chance to lead a regional Client Engagement team at a pivotal moment: with a clear global strategy, a product that clients rely on daily, and the mandate to shape how we retain and grow our client base for years to come.

Our product security engineers work alongside Product Engineering teams, contributing to planning, design, code and delivery. They report to you for technical development, performance and career progression. You’ll stay close enough to their work to support them well, even when you are not part of their day-to-day team.



You’ll bring experience as a security engineer and as a people manager. You should be able to challenge a design, reason through a threat model and help an engineer find a practical solution. You’ll also need to make choices about where we invest, build relationships across engineering and explain security priorities in terms of customer and business risk.




WHAT YOU’LL DO


 - Lead and develop our product and platform security engineers through regular feedback, coaching, clear expectations and fair performance assessment.

 - Build a focused security engineering strategy and roadmap, informed by our products, engineering plans and the risks that matter most.

 - Grow the team thoughtfully, identifying capability gaps and taking responsibility for hiring and onboarding.

 - Agree sustained product security placements with engineering leaders, with clear priorities, useful feedback and a strong connection to the security team.

 - Help teams build security into architecture and implementation, including access control, tenant isolation, confidential data handling and AI systems.

 - Work with Platform Engineering to make secure infrastructure and delivery practices easy to adopt, using shared controls and automation where they help.

 - Stay involved in important technical decisions through design and code reviews, investigations and selective implementation.

 - Help engineers raise concerns and resolve disagreements constructively. Make material risks and trade-offs clear to the leaders accountable for the decision.

 - Partner with IT and Information Security on shared risks, incident response and assurance requirements.

 - Measure whether our approach reduces meaningful risk and helps engineers deliver securely. Use what we learn to improve it.
   
   
   


WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR


 - A background in hands-on security engineering, with strong product or application security experience.

 - Demonstrated line management experience: developing engineers, giving difficult feedback, assessing performance and supporting career progression.

 - Experience supporting engineers whose daily work happens within other teams, or comparable evidence of managing effectively without observing all their work directly.

 - Current technical judgement across secure software design, threat modelling, authentication, authorisation and protection of sensitive data.

 - Enough cloud and platform security breadth to guide specialists and make sound decisions across both areas.

 - Experience setting priorities and securing support for security improvements across engineering teams.

 - The ability to explain risk clearly, offer workable options and make proportionate recommendations under uncertainty.

 - A collaborative approach that helps product and platform engineers own the security of the systems they build.
   
   

You should be comfortable reading and reviewing production code and discussing implementation choices. The role combines technical leadership with people management and responsibility for building the function.





USEFUL EXPERIENCE


 - Working with AWS, backend services, infrastructure as code and automated delivery.

 - Securing multi-tenant products, confidential customer data or AI-enabled systems.

 - Building or improving a small security engineering team in a growing organisation.

 - Introducing secure patterns or tooling that engineers adopted and continued to use.
   
   

We value evidence of sound judgement and useful outcomes. You do not need experience with every technology we use.
